text:
Jane (CSM): AltairWorks go-live set for next Thursday. QA found p95 ~1.1s for /embed-doc but occasional 2s+ spikes during large doc batches. want a minimal perf playbook we can run this week. thoughts?
Sam (CS Ops): agree we should preempt. i'd prefer a safe approach: small canary + geo pinning + tighter batching settings. keep customer in loop. :white_check_mark:
Devon (ML Eng): here's a low-risk plan: 1) swap embedding route to redwood-compact-v1-int8 for US traffic only, 2) keep eu traffic on fp16 model, 3) enable micro-batching window 25ms and dynamic batch size cap 32, 4) enable prefix KV cache for doc prefixes. Canary schedule: 3% for 3h -> 15% for 12h -> evaluate.
Andre (Support): what metrics do we watch for rollback? latency alone or quality too?
Devon (ML Eng): monitor three things: p95 latency, median latency, and semantic recall (avg cosine similarity vs baseline eval). auto-rollback if avg cosine drop > 0.01 OR p95 improvement < 15% at 15% canary (means no perf gain).
Lee (AltairOps): Altair hits /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat. primary is us-west-2; smaller traffic from eu-west-1. we want minimal change to chat for now.
Sam (CS Ops): ok we'll only touch embed route. I'll prepare customer note explaining risk: small centroid drift on very long docs, recommend reindexing if they rely on exact chunk ids.
Devon (ML Eng): adding debug hooks: X-Trace-Sample: 1/200 and capture 200 first canary requests. also record top 50 mismatch samples to #altair-debug. add eval set altair_embed_smoke_v3.
Jane (CSM): can you paste the rollout config so i can send to the customer?
Devon (ML Eng): sure:
```json
{
  "route": "embed-doc",
  "stages": [{"pct": 3, "dur": "3h"}, {"pct": 15, "dur": "12h"}],
  "model_us": "redwood-compact-v1-int8",
  "model_eu": "redwood-base-v1-fp16",
  "batching": {"window_ms": 25, "max_batch": 32},
  "kv_prefix_cache": true,
  "trace_sample_ratio": "1/200",
  "eval_set": "altair_embed_smoke_v3",
  "quality_threshold_cosine_drop": "0.01"
}
```
Sam (CS Ops): ops-bot can you create rollout RD-5010 and perf channel #altair-ops? set automatic rollback on quality or no perf win.
ops-bot: created RD-5010, channel #altair-ops, configured rollback on cosine_drop > 0.01 or p95_improvement < 0.15. Canary job scheduled for Tue 09:00 PT.
Andre (Support): i'll standby during canary window and triage any customer tickets. Lee, can you approve the schedule?
Lee (AltairOps): approved. Tue 09:00 PT works. please also throttle eu bursts to avoid cross-region noise.
Jane (CSM): action list: Devon apply config + traces, Sam send customer comms and schedule, ops-bot run canary, Andre monitor support, Lee will throttle eu and monitor. follow-up sync 24h after full rollout. thanks all :rocket:
